cards.stem: How is density defined for a gas substance?
cards.quote: Density is the mass per volume of a substance.

cards.stem: At what speed does the density of the fluid typically remain constant?
cards.quote: If the object passes at a low speed (typically less than 200 mph), the density of the fluid remains constant.

cards.stem: What layer is created when gas molecules stick to a surface?
cards.quote: Gas molecules stick to any surface, creating a layer of air near the surface (called a boundary layer)
cards.hint: Recall the effect of stickiness on shape

cards.stem: What is produced near and beyond the speed of sound?
cards.quote: Near and beyond the speed of sound (about 700 mph), shock waves are produced that affect both the lift and drag of an object.
cards.hint: Think about high speed compressibility effects
